titles.native: グッド・モーニング!!!ドロンジョ

description:
The 3rd in a series of Flash animation shows following “Good Morning Genie Family”. Doronjo, Boyacky, and Tonzra, the iconic villains from “Yatterman”, engage in an endless chain of unproductive conversations. With even the characters from “Good Morning Gatchaman” making appearances, the parties face off in an interesting battle!

(Source: Official Site)
